messages.text: Pushed v14 of the Falcon merger model to the deal folder. Main changes: updated Northwind LTM EBITDA with the July close, and rolled the synergy schedule to phase in over 36 months instead of 24.
Thanks Aisha. Does the 36-month phasing flow through to the accretion/dilution tab or just the synergy summary? Want to make sure year-1 EPS isn't still showing the old run-rate.
Both. I relinked the accretion tab, year-1 is now roughly 40% of run-rate synergies vs. 60% before. Accretion drops a bit but still positive by year 2.
Comps update: I refreshed the trading multiples for the freight and logistics set. Median EV/EBITDA moved from 9.8x to 9.4x after the sector sell-off this week. Sheet is tab 'Comps_0821'.

Good. Let's not chase the multiple down in the football field though. Keep the range anchored on the precedent transactions and show comps as a cross-check. Susan, can you add the control premium bridge?
Will do, should have it in the model by end of day.
Financing question for the model: are we still assuming 5.0x total leverage at close? Lender feedback this morning was that the term loan B pricing might widen 25bps.
Keep 5.0x as base, but add a sensitivity at 5.5x and +50bps on pricing. The client will want to see the interest coverage impact before the board session.
On it. I'll add a two-way table: leverage vs. spread, showing coverage and pro forma net debt/EBITDA.

Compliance reminder for the team: please keep all model versions inside the restricted deal folder only. No attachments in email or personal drives. Also, file names should use the project code name, no target references.
Understood Marcus. v14 is already in the restricted folder, and I'll check the older versions for naming this afternoon.

Quick flag: found a circularity in the interest calc on the debt schedule after Aisha's relink. Turned on iterative calc as a stopgap, but we should switch to average-balance with a circ breaker toggle.
My bad, that's from the revolver sweep. I'll add the circ breaker and push v15 tonight with the leverage sensitivities too.
Great work, all. Let's lock v15 by Monday 10am so I can review before the client call. Tom, please send the change log to the channel once it's up.
